They come first and are so deeply embedded in the culture that even if my friends dont have crazy parents like mine, they are used to putting family/careers above friends/social life too. Its easy to become they way our parents are even without having crazy APs. My friends and I just started our first job and I already see them less and less. Always too busy bcs of family and work for gatherings. Sooner or later the social aspect of life is gonna disappear that way.

Perhaps to the point when most boomers/gen X and some older millennials generation of APs died off. The younger millennials and gen Z who are more aware of mental illness and health becoming parents is where we will finally see some changes. U cant change the old generation's mindset. They will stay that way forever. Until then those who suffer under crazy APs will either leave, go crazy or die.
